## Activity

Central Eye Clinic completed 100 image captures during January 2021. Activity was recorded for the full reporting period, with the site maintaining its routine imaging service. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures outlined below.

## Image quality

Of the 100 captures, 2 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.0 per cent. The result should continue to be monitored as part of routine quality assurance. Where image quality is insufficient for assessment, the cause should be considered and any recurring technical problems reported through the appropriate support route.

The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support follow-up, help identify repeated faults and provide a record of actions taken at site level.

## Grading

Grading identified 25 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 1 day. The site should continue to review the timeliness of grading alongside referral outcomes and image quality. This will help maintain oversight of the service and ensure that operational issues are identified and addressed promptly.
